method: Read all final bilingual statements, qualifiers and selected excerpts against all 103 original blocks and round-1 criteria. This evaluation was not sent to the generation or revision model.
scope: Microsoft FY2025 Operating Segments subsection, not full report or blind holdout.

resolved_findings.detail: Prior short quotations have been expanded to include definition clauses, missing conditions, antecedents and list introductions. The 17 issues from Opus are materially corrected.
Commercial Windows/Power BI scopes, low-code Dynamics, EMS/LinkedIn competitive categories, GitHub/Nuance use cases, Azure Security and studio investment now appear in the prose.
The earlier claim inverted the source relationship. Final i18 correctly states that unique gaming experiences are the cornerstone of Game Pass.
